title: Precessing Black Hole Jets and Galactic Fossils
summary: The Galactic Center gamma-ray excess (GCE) -- a surplus of gamma-ray radiation around SgrA$^{\star}$ -- has remained without a consensus interpretation for more than fifteen years. Dark-matter annihilation and unresolved millisecond-pulsar populations remain the leading candidates, yet neither connects the excess to the past activity of SgrA$^{\star}$ traced by the Fermi and eROSITA bubbles.
